# `operations.aug`

<a id="symbol-step"></a>
## `step` · [source](operations.aug#L2)

It takes `value` as an integer. It sets `product` to (`value` times `48271`) plus `1`. It returns `product` minus ((`product` divided by `2147483647`) times `2147483647`).
